mapper.select: select e.id, e.username, e.password, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.job, e.salary, e.image, e.entry_date as entryDate, e.create_time as createTime, e.update_time as updateTime, ee.id as expr_id, ee.emp_id as expr_empId, ee.begin as expr_begin, ee.end as expr_end, ee.school_name as expr_schoolName, ee.job as expr_job from emp e left join emp_expr ee on e.id = ee.emp_id where e.id = #{id} order by ee.begin desc, ee.id desc
